narrative.overview: Personal progress reads as an open, measured page. Warm matte paper, olive ink, and thin rules support dated evidence. Editorial headings orient readers while native iOS controls and system text carry workout and form interactions.
keyCharacteristics: clay accent for actions and measured change
native iOS controls and tab chrome

rules.name: The Measured Accent Rule
rules.body: Use clay for actions and actual progress; keep rules, category badges, and supporting labels neutral.

rules.name: The Editorial Heading Rule
rules.body: Serif type orients a page or record; dense set data and form controls stay in system sans.

dos: Place units and dates with measured values; use monospaced digits where comparison matters.
Show goal, exercise, and volume changes from stored records and explain missing readings honestly.
Keep native controls and Dynamic Type behavior in form and training flows.
donts: Restore repeated enclosed cards on reading screens.
Use clay as category decoration or imply a trend changed without a reading in the period.
Add illustrative values, slogans, or anatomy art from the approved comp as product data.
